long_biography.plain_text:
Seeing a drag race by chance in America captured Sheikh Marwan Al Mualla's imagination. He had already raced in the desert as a youngster before moving on to motorcycles. Developing Emirates Motorplex required organisers as well as a track, so his team sent Emirati personnel to train in Kuwait and Bahrain.

School and university fees became a focus of his work at the Umm Al Quwain Charity Association. As chairman, he directed the association to fund school fees for children from low-income households and tuition for university students. The charity also supplied schoolbags to younger pupils.
